name: Tállya (Hungary)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of red, white and blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Tállya: a crowned blue shield with a figure and a bunch of grapes, with a helm, a sabre crest and red, white and blue mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Tállya arms with crown, helm, crest and mantling
